title: Moving in With Grandparents
sentences: When my parents decided to move abroad for work, I stayed behind with my grandparents.
At first, I was nervous because we hadn't lived together since I was a small child.
Their house felt quiet and old-fashioned compared to the flat I was used to.
However, I quickly got used to their routines, like eating dinner early every evening.
My grandmother taught me to cook several dishes that I'd never tried before.
While we were living together, we grew much closer than we had ever been.
Sometimes we disagreed, especially about how late I should stay out with friends.
Even so, I always felt supported, and they never made me feel like a guest.
Since my parents came back, I've realised how much I miss that daily company.
My brother, who stayed with an aunt instead, had a completely different experience.
Looking back, I think that year brought our whole family closer together.
